integrity: Exact mathematical proof and reproducible rational arithmetic checker; finite simplex integrations corroborate rather than replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a full-dimensional sparse-paving base polytope and applies to uniform continuous interior volume, not uniform vertices. Covariance isotropy is classified within the degree-regular subfamily; the general converse is not asserted. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Volume moments detect block designs in sparse-paving matroid polytopes
